name: scripts
//: The repository's scripts — the toolchain and gate plumbing (bun.sh, nx, nx-base.sh, coverage.sh, msrv.sh), CI's tier router, the installers (install.sh, setup-llmlint.sh, session-setup.sh) and the bench drivers — with their subprocess tests in tests/. Its own project so a change to the crate never reruns these tests (one of them builds a scratch crate under cargo-llvm-cov), and so install.sh reaches the live GitHub project without dragging the crate along.

options.command: for f in scripts/*.sh scripts/nx; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done && sh -n scripts/install.sh && sh -n scripts/install-nextest.sh

lint.//: Syntax-checks every script with the shell that runs it (install.sh and install-nextest.sh are POSIX sh).
